title: EUDR Compliance Engine
thesis: Snowflake automates EUDR due diligence at scale — geospatial polygon checks against deforestation baselines, Dynamic Tables compile compliance dossiers per shipment, and Cortex AI generates regulatory narratives

talking_points: 15,000 plot polygons verified against post-2020 deforestation baseline.
94.2% of active shipments are EUDR-compliant — 1,160 shipments still pending verification.
3,000 due diligence statements generated — 2,740 ready for EU submission.
tabs.call_out: 94.2% compliant — 1,160 shipments still need polygon verification

transition.line: Let's look at where the deforestation risk is geographically.

talking_points: Heat map shows deforestation risk concentrated in Central Kalimantan and Riau provinces.
47 plots overlap with post-2020 deforestation areas — requires field verification or exclusion.
Satellite alerts processed daily — 100,000 GLAD alert points classified by confidence.
show: Zoom into Central Kalimantan overlap plots
tabs.call_out: 47 plots with deforestation overlap — Central Kalimantan highest risk

transition.line: The geospatial checks are automated. Let's see the compliance engine.

talking_points: Dynamic Tables automatically compile per-shipment compliance dossiers with evidence links.
Cortex AI generates due diligence statement narratives from structured compliance data.
Each DDS links to polygon checks, satellite verification, and chain-of-custody evidence.
show: Show a generated DDS with evidence links
Point at the AI-generated narrative section
tabs.call_out: Automated DDS generation — from polygon check to regulatory narrative

transition.line: Now let the CSO ask the system about compliance status.

talking_points: Hendra asks: 'What percentage of our shipments are EUDR-compliant?'
Cortex Analyst queries compliance data — returns 94.2% with breakdown by province.
Follow-up: 'Which supply chains in Riau have deforestation risk?' — agent provides plot-level detail.
show: Switch to advisory mode for risk detail
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: compliance analytics + regulatory advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, geospatial functions.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
Snowflake GEOGRAPHY functions replace Amazon Location Service for polygon operations.
Indonesia faces Rp 200T+ in export revenue risk if EUDR compliance fails for palm oil.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native geospatial, automated EUDR compliance

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for EUDR compliance.
